name: Perform statistical analysis and calculations on datasets
description: Users asked to perform descriptive and inferential statistical calculations on provided datasets, including computing measures of central tendency, building frequency distributions, and conducting regression or hypothesis tests. The requests ranged from simple arithmetic on small lists to complex multivariate analyses, often requiring specific numerical outputs or interpretations of the results.
